# SKSurrogate

> One open-source tool from dataset registration to deployed, monitored models — surrogate-based optimization, statistical evaluation (nested CV + conformal intervals), sensitivity analysis, experiment design for expensive runs, and a research workspace that tracks evidence. Built on scikit-learn; drop-in BaseSearchCV tuner included.

## Install
- `pip install sksurrogate` (PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/sksurrogate/) — Python >= 3.10, scikit-learn
- Package name: `sksurrogate`; import name: `SKSurrogate`
- Main API: `SKSurrogate.SurrogateRandomCV` (drop-in `RandomizedSearchCV`), `SKSurrogate.AML`

## Citation
- Ghasemi, Mehdi (2026). SKSurrogate: a Python toolkit for surrogate-based optimization of expensive functions. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23631823
- Benchmark data: 10.5281/zenodo.23629024 · D-track study: 10.5281/zenodo.23652613

## Key facts
- The benchmark suite is equal-budget (candidate-model evaluations) and published with raw records; on six public datasets Optuna-TPE is top on 5 of 6 at B=30.
- The default response surface is an un-tuned RBF GaussianProcessRegressor; the legacy cubic Hilbert polynomial is retained.
- Not a managed cloud service; self-hosted, single compose profile, port 8013.
- Author: Mehdi Ghasemi — https://mghasemi.net · ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9551-1780
